editorial.description_en: Leaves on the ground rather than on the tree, past their colour and into their brown.
editorial.description_ja: 地に散った葉のような、赤みのある茶。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.518, C 0.086, h 60.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 散り (chiri, scattering) + 葉 (ha, leaf), rendaku to -ba. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Scattered Leaf" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 散葉. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — furu-kawa at ΔE00 4.0, sabi-suna at ΔE00 7.3, doro-kabe at ΔE00 7.4. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (240°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
